# Flynt

Flynt uses warm, low-contrast tones for a calm reading and writing environment. The recorded description describes minimalist styling that removes visual noise so notes stay clear and readable, and the theme index lists both dark and light modes.

![Flynt screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flynt-theme/flynt-obsidian/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Flynt"
    author: "kylebsingh"
    repo:   "flynt-theme/flynt-obsidian"
    slug:   "flynt"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/flynt"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/flynt-theme/flynt-obsidian"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flynt-theme/flynt-obsidian/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply warm, low-contrast tones for a calm reading and writing environment. Remove visual noise with minimalist styling to keep notes clear, readable, and focused."
}
```
